answer: At the block where a sponsor's stake is locked and the vouch hash is anchored, trust passes to the new agent. That moment is one-shot: the stake is escrowed and the vouch nonce is consumed in the same write, so a second claim on that signal points at a spent nonce and fails. A fresh key sits on no ledge of reputation until that anchor lands, and the sponsor cannot reuse the collateral across any horizon.
